title: Primary garden area maximum permanent roof cover 35%
text: Primary garden area (applies to R50-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR and HR only). C1.1.3 A single consolidated primary garden area to be provided in accordance with Table 1.1b. Table 1.1b Primary garden area provisions. Maximum permanent roof cover(1): 35% of the primary garden area provided. 1 Permanent roof cover excludes minor projections (eaves).

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: 35% of the primary garden area provided (not of the minimum). Permanent roof cover excludes eaves.
